routines.name: Martha-VM · Weekly Voice Mining
routines.description: Sunday 5:00 AM ET weekly Gmail voice-mining run. Reads marc@teamtoday.ca (last 30 days of professional email), runs Sonnet 4.6 (NEVER Haiku) to extract: tone register, top-30 phrases, objection templates, banned phrases, sentence-length distribution, voice anchors. Output is committed to netlify/functions/_lib/voice-profile.json on main via the GitHub Contents API. Apollos / Boaz / Aaron / Asher / Lydia / Asaph all read this file on cold start (with frozen-baseline fallback). Anti-drift IP for the entire content stack. Lands BEFORE Apollos's Sunday 7pm magazine.

routines.status_detail: Built 2026-05-02 per cornerstoneregroup-site PR #23 (feat/martha-vm-voice-mining). Ports n8n workflow IvpMqKNmxhcS27yH (mine_teamtoday_emails). Required env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (hard), GITHUB_MASTER_KEY (hard for commit). Required env (Gmail Path A — set on Netlify as of 2026-05-02): GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID + GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET + GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN_TEAMTODAY. Without these, function exits clean with 'no-creds' reason — cron does not crash, existing voice-profile.json keeps the content stack live (degraded mode). First fire: Sun May 3 2026 5:00 AM ET.
